newsitem.title: UK: British World Airlines orders a pair of ATPs.
newsitem.headline: British World Airlines orders a pair of ATPs.

text.p: British World Airlines said in a statement it has ordered a pair of new AIR(BAe)ATPs to its fleet.

The first aircraft which is to be delivered in August, will have a 68 seat QC (Quick Change) configuration and has a 7.5 tonnes capacity as a pure freighter. The second will follow shortly afterwards.
"We have already established that there is a strong interest in the ATP and we would certainly add to the fleet if the aircraft are a success" said the sales director Mike Sessions.
"The ATP can operate out of most airports without any restrictions and will give us more flexibility at very competitive prices" he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
